title: SolarPunk Closed Pilot Execution Package
purpose: Remove vague blockers by converting the path from public lab to closed pilot into concrete inputs, commands, caps, and acceptance criteria.

execution_modes.value_claim: External demo, grant/reviewer proof, reproducible testnet lab.
execution_modes.execution_command: Open frontend demo and run npm run product:launch-gate
execution_modes.success_definition: Reviewer can inspect Sepolia proof, adapter sample, hardware model, economics model, and frontend without trusting private claims.

execution_modes.value_claim: Use a real operator export or LAN inverter source for evidence, but no paid mint/redeem obligation.
execution_modes.success_definition: Hardware model upgrades from L0 to at least L2 and the verifier accepts signed, monotonic, closed-window readings.

execution_modes.value_claim: Named operator, capped testnet SPK flow, governed deployment, no public real-money exposure.
execution_modes.execution_command: Run governed redeploy/readback, operator adapter receipt, hardware provenance model, economics refresh, then product launch gate.
execution_modes.success_definition: Governed attested-SPK deployment, L2+ hardware source, and signed economics/support terms clear launch gate.

execution_modes.value_claim: L3 revenue-grade or L4 utility-corroborated source with audit/legal/reserve guardrails.
execution_modes.execution_command: Upgrade operator evidence to L3/L4, complete audit/legal/reserve policy, then reassess paid launch gate.
execution_modes.success_definition: Revenue-grade/utility corroboration plus non-hardware launch gates; until then, no paid/mainnet claims.

operator_intake.why: Binds the pilot receipt to a named physical generator without publishing private customer data.
Moves hardware provenance from sample L0 toward live-source L2.
Cumulative counters let the adapter reject non-monotonic data and derive deterministic surplus.
The protocol can verify signatures only if signer custody and revocation are defined.
The current lowest-support archetype still needs about $0.3298/kWh or equivalent capex/support terms.
Optional at L2, but needed to move toward L3/L4 real-value credibility.

action_queue.acceptance_criteria: Public Lab gate remains launchable with 0 blocking checks.
Cumulative counters, device identity, signer custody, and operator identity are provided for one closed interval.
Accepted records > 0, rejected records = 0 or explained, hardware provenance upgrades to L2+.

action_queue.command_or_artifact: npm run deploy:pilot-stack:sepolia && npm run pilot-stack:readback
action_queue.acceptance_criteria: Deployment scope is governed-attested-spk-pilot with source verification and role readback.
At minimum, the 10 kW path needs about $0.3298/kWh realized value or $2,875.48/year support equivalent under current assumptions.

action_queue.command_or_artifact: npm run product:hardware-provenance && npm run product:economic-launch && npm run product:launch-gate
action_queue.acceptance_criteria: Closed pilot gate moves from blocked to launchable, while paid/mainnet remains separately gated.

no_excuse_boundary: There are no undefined blockers left in this package. Anything not launchable is mapped to a named input, command, acceptance criterion, and owner. The package still refuses to mislabel sample data as real hardware proof.
